gold_facts.text: The court is competent to modify court-ordered measures on the allocation and protection of children in divorce proceedings, in proceedings to modify the divorce judgment, and in proceedings to modify measures protecting the marital union.
In all other cases the child protection authority is competent.

competing_candidates: The divorce rule on new arrangements after a change of circumstances (child protection authority competent where the parents agree) and the rule on the court's competence to order child protection measures in marital proceedings both bear on competence; the question stays general about modifying court-ordered child measures.
provenance.critic_notes: 'In den übrigen Fällen ist die Kindesschutzbehörde zuständig.' Facts match Abs 1-2 in 3 langs. 210:134 Abs 3 and 210:179 touch modification after divorce or of Eheschutz, but the general competence split is only in 315b. de 445.

question: Ein Gericht hat bei unserer Trennung festgelegt, bei wem die Kinder leben und wie sie geschützt werden. Wer darf diese Regelung später ändern: nur das Gericht, oder auch die Kindesschutzbehörde? Hängt das davon ab, ob gerade ein Scheidungsverfahren läuft?

gold_facts.text: The divorce court regulates the parents' rights and duties under the rules on the effects of parentage, in particular parental authority, custody, personal contact or each parent's share in care, and maintenance.
The court takes into account all circumstances important for the child's welfare, the parents' joint request and, as far as possible, the child's opinion.
A parent who does not hold parental authority or custody and the minor child have a mutual right to the personal contact appropriate to the circumstances.
A parent can demand that his or her right to personal contact be regulated.

competing_candidates: Neighbouring rules on limits and refusal of personal contact and on information rights of the non-custodial parent touch the same topic.
provenance.critic_notes: 133 Ziff 3 'den persönlichen Verkehr (Art. 273)'; 273 Abs 1 'haben gegenseitig Anspruch auf angemessenen persönlichen Verkehr'. Second article needed for the contact right. Facts supported. fr 21.

question: Nous divorçons et nos enfants vivront chez leur mère. Qu'est-ce que le juge doit régler au sujet des enfants dans le divorce, et est-ce que j'aurai le droit de continuer à les voir même si je ne les ai pas chez moi ?

gold_facts.text: A marriage is declared invalid if, at the time it was concluded, one spouse was already married or in a registered partnership with a third person and that earlier marriage or partnership had not been dissolved.

competing_candidates: The rules on who may bring the invalidity action and on the effects of a judgment of invalidity are neighbours; the impediment of an existing marriage also appears among the conditions for marrying.
provenance.critic_notes: Ziff 1: 'einer der Ehegatten bereits verheiratet ist ... nicht aufgelöst worden ist'. it 3: sposato, sciolto are everyday words, not a distinctive copy. 210:96 (impediment) is a neighbour on conditions, not validity. Easy is correct.

question: Ho scoperto che mio marito, quando ci siamo sposati, era ancora sposato con un'altra donna all'estero e quel primo matrimonio non era mai stato sciolto. Il nostro matrimonio è comunque valido?

gold_facts.text: The freely disposable portion is calculated on the state of the estate at the time of death.
The deceased's debts, funeral costs, costs of sealing and of the inventory are deducted.
The cost of maintaining for one month the persons who lived with the deceased is also deducted.

competing_candidates: The rule adding certain lifetime gifts to the estate for the calculation, and the forced-share percentages, are related but separate parts of the calculation.
provenance.critic_notes: 'Der verfügbare Teil berechnet sich nach dem Stande des Vermögens zur Zeit des Todes'; deductions Abs 2 in 3 langs. 'what gets subtracted first' slightly implies an order the text lacks; harmless. 210:475 (gifts added) is separate. No lexical signal.

question: My father died and his will leaves as much as possible to my stepmother. To work out how much of his estate he was free to give away, at what point in time are his assets valued, and what gets subtracted first?

gold_facts.text: Each party may request that the contract be adapted to the new circumstances in the decision granting the extension.
If the extension decision does not change it, the contract continues to apply unchanged during the extension, subject to the statutory means of adjustment.

competing_candidates: The provisions on the conditions and length of the extension decide whether an extension is granted, not its effect on the contract terms.
provenance.critic_notes: 'Jede Partei kann verlangen, dass der Vertrag im Erstreckungsentscheid ... angepasst wird' (272c). 272/272b are conditions and length. de=2, 'angepasst' natural.

question: Nach der Kündigung meiner Wohnung hat das Gericht mein Mietverhältnis um ein Jahr verlängert. Gilt der bisherige Vertrag in dieser Zeit genau so weiter, oder können der Vermieter oder ich verlangen, dass er angepasst wird?

gold_facts.text: The general meeting must be convened if at least one tenth of the members, or, in cooperatives with fewer than 30 members, at least three members, request it.
If the administration does not comply within a reasonable time, the court orders the meeting to be convened on the application of the requesting members.

competing_candidates: The stock company and limited liability company rules on convening at shareholders' request are similar; the question names a cooperative.
provenance.critic_notes: 'bei Genossenschaften von weniger als 30 Mitgliedern, mindestens drei Genossenschafter' (881 Abs.2). AG 699 Abs.3/5 uses capital thresholds; question names a cooperative.

question: I belong to a housing cooperative with 25 members, and the board refuses to call a general meeting. How many of us need to ask for one before the board must hold it, and what can we do if the board still does nothing?

gold_facts.text: The company may acquire its own shares only if it has freely disposable equity equal to the acquisition cost.
The acquisition of own shares is limited to 10 percent of the share capital entered in the commercial register.

If the acquisition is linked to a transfer restriction or an action for dissolution, the limit is 20 percent, and shares above 10 percent must be sold or cancelled by a capital reduction within two years.

competing_candidates: The limited liability company has its own rule on acquiring its own capital shares with different limits; the question names a stock company.
provenance.critic_notes: 'à concurrence de 10 % du capital-actions' (659 al.2). GmbH 783 has different limits (35 %) and question names SA. fr=1 from generic terms.

question: Notre société anonyme aimerait racheter les actions d'un actionnaire qui veut se retirer. À quelles conditions la société peut-elle détenir ses propres actions, et jusqu'à quelle part du capital ?

gold_facts.text: The report must be written in a national language or in English.
The report must be published electronically within six months after the end of the financial year and remain publicly accessible for at least ten years.
The rules on keeping and retaining business records apply by analogy to these reports.
The retention period is ten years and runs from the end of the financial year.

competing_candidates: The report on non-financial matters has similar publication and retention rules; the question names the conflict-minerals and child-labour report.
provenance.critic_notes: 964l: 'redatta in una lingua nazionale o in inglese', six months, ten years; cpv.4 refers to 958f (ten years from end of year). 964c has similar rules for the non-financial report but question names minerals and child labour. it=56.

question: La nostra azienda deve fare ogni anno un rapporto su come controlla che nella sua catena di fornitura non ci siano metalli provenienti da zone di guerra né bambini che lavorano. In che lingua va scritto, entro quando va pubblicato, per quanto tempo deve restare consultabile e da quando decorre il periodo di conservazione?

gold_facts.text: A suretyship given by a married person is valid only with the written consent of the spouse, given in advance or at the latest at the same time, unless the marriage has been separated by court judgment.

For later changes, the spouse's consent is needed only if the amount of liability is increased, a simple suretyship is turned into a joint and several one, or the change considerably reduces the securities.

provenance.critic_notes: 'consenso scritto del coniuge ... anticipatamente o al più tardi simultaneamente' (494 cpv.1) and cpv.3 for increases. No competitor. it=74.

question: Mio marito vuole fare da garante personale per il prestito di un suo amico. Gli serve il mio consenso, e in che forma e quando? E se più avanti l'importo garantito venisse aumentato, dovrebbe chiedermelo di nuovo?

gold_facts.text: If the landlord does not hand over the thing on the agreed date, or hands it over with defects that exclude or considerably impair its intended use, the tenant may rely on the general rules on non-performance of contracts.
If the tenant accepts the thing despite such defects and demands proper performance, he can only assert the claims he would have for defects arising during the lease.

competing_candidates: The provisions on the tenant's rights for defects arising during the lease are referred to and give the content of those claims.
provenance.critic_notes: 'so kann der Mieter nach den Artikeln 107-109 ... vorgehen' and Abs.2 (258). 259a ff give the content of defect claims but the handover rule is in 258. de=155.

question: Ich sollte am Monatsersten in meine neue Mietwohnung einziehen, aber wegen eines Wasserschadens ist sie praktisch unbewohnbar. Welche Rechte habe ich gegenüber dem Vermieter? Und ändert sich etwas, wenn ich trotzdem einziehe und verlange, dass er den Schaden behebt?

gold_facts.text: The beneficiary lives in the debtor's household, and the debtor owes the services that the value of the property received and the beneficiary's previous social position fairly allow her to expect.
The debtor must in particular provide suitable food and lodging, and in case of illness the necessary care and medical assistance.

provenance.critic_notes: All facts in 524 al.1-2 (fr: 'une nourriture et un logement convenables; en cas de maladie... les soins'). 521 defines the contract only; 522 form not asked. No twin. Natural EN, no lexical signal.

question: My elderly aunt handed over her house to a cousin, who in return agreed to take her into his home and look after her for the rest of her life. What exactly does he owe her, for example if she falls ill?

gold_facts.text: If the limited partnership did business before being entered in the commercial register, the limited partner is liable to third parties like a partner with unlimited liability for the partnership's obligations that arose before registration.
This unlimited liability does not apply if the limited partner proves that the third parties knew his liability was limited.

competing_candidates: The general limited-partnership rule that the limited partner is liable only up to the registered limited sum (it states the normal limit, not the pre-registration exception).
provenance.critic_notes: Revised to extent of liability only; 220:604 no longer bears. fr: 'tenu ... comme un associé indéfiniment responsable' unless third parties knew the limit. FR rank 6.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: asks only about the extent of liability, not about being sued alone.

question: Avec deux amis, nous avons fondé une société en commandite dans laquelle je ne réponds des dettes que jusqu'à un montant fixé. Avant même que la société soit inscrite au registre du commerce, elle a passé des commandes chez un fournisseur. Envers ce fournisseur, ma responsabilité reste-t-elle limitée à ce montant ?

gold_facts.text: Rights and obligations from a contract concluded by an authorised representative in another person's name pass to the person represented.

If the representative did not disclose that he was acting as a representative, the represented person becomes directly creditor or debtor only if the other party had to infer the agency from the circumstances or did not care with whom it contracted.

competing_candidates: The mandate rule on claims acquired by a mandatary in his own name passing to the principal (the delivery sub-question was removed so it no longer bears on the question).
provenance.critic_notes: Delivery sub-question and assignment fact removed, so 220:401 no longer competes. it 32(2): 'il rappresentato diventa direttamente creditore o debitore' only if inferable or indifferent.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: delivery sub-question and assignment fact removed.

question: Ho autorizzato mio fratello a comprare per me un'auto usata da un privato. Lui l'ha acquistata, ma al venditore non ha mai detto che lo faceva per conto mio. Adesso chi è vincolato al venditore dal contratto, io o mio fratello?

gold_facts.text: Where wages below those customary for the place, occupation or sector are repeatedly and abusively offered and no collective agreement with minimum wage provisions can be declared generally binding, the competent authority may, at the request of the tripartite commission, issue a fixed-term standard employment contract with minimum wages differentiated by region.

The validity of such a standard employment contract can be extended for a fixed period, on the commission's proposal, if its minimum wage rules are repeatedly breached or new abuses are expected after it expires.
The Confederation and each canton set up a tripartite commission made up of equal numbers of employer and employee representatives plus representatives of the state.

When the commission finds such abuses it normally first seeks a direct agreement with the employers concerned, and if none is reached within two months it proposes a standard employment contract with minimum wages to the competent authority.

competing_candidates: The general article on the standard employment contract and how it is issued (it does not set the minimum wage conditions or the commission's role).
provenance.critic_notes: 360a al.1+3 and 360b al.1+3 support all facts (de: 'suchen sie in der Regel eine direkte Verständigung'). Both articles needed (who/how vs. fixed term). 360d is effects only. High BM25 ranks, natural EN.

question: In my canton, cleaning firms keep paying new staff far below what is normal in the region, and there is no sector-wide collective agreement with minimum wages that could be made binding for everyone. Who can get a compulsory minimum wage imposed for this sector, how is the problem normally handled before that happens, and would such a minimum wage apply forever?

gold_facts.text: The debtor may issue a global certificate or replace several fungible securities entrusted to a single custodian with one, provided the terms of issue or the articles of association allow it or the depositors have consented.
The global certificate is a security of the same type as the individual rights it represents.
It is co-owned by the participating depositors in proportion to their holdings.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring article on collective custody of fungible securities, which also gives depositors co-ownership of the pooled stock (it does not deal with replacing papers by one certificate).
provenance.critic_notes: 973b supports all three facts (de: 'Sie steht im Miteigentum der daran beteiligten Hinterleger'). 973a (collective custody) is related but does not cover the global certificate. No lexical copy (DE 350).

question: Ich habe zusammen mit vielen anderen Anlegern gleichartige Obligationen eines Unternehmens bei derselben Bank hinterlegt. Jetzt will das Unternehmen alle unsere einzelnen Papiere durch eine einzige Sammelurkunde ersetzen. Darf es das ohne Weiteres, und was ist diese eine Urkunde dann rechtlich, wem gehört sie?

gold_facts.text: A simple partnership is dissolved when a partner dies, unless it was agreed beforehand that it would continue with the heirs.
A partner may terminate the partnership by notice if this is reserved in the contract or if the partnership was entered into for an indefinite period or for a partner's lifetime.
For important reasons, dissolution may be demanded without prior notice where the partnership was concluded for an indefinite period.

competing_candidates: The following simple-partnership article on the notice period for termination (the question does not ask for the period).
The general-partnership dissolution rules, which refer to the simple-partnership rules.
provenance.critic_notes: 545 al.1 ch.2/6 and al.2 support facts (de: 'ohne vorherige Aufkündigung verlangt werden'). 546 (6-month notice) complements fact 2 but is not asked. Note: dissolution for good cause is by court judgment (al.1 ch.7); acceptable. No lexical signal.

question: Four of us run an informal joint venture together (a simple partnership, not a registered company) with no end date agreed. One of the partners has just died, and we never agreed anything about what happens with his heirs. Does the partnership come to an end because of his death? And apart from that, could one of us end it at once for a serious reason without first giving notice?

gold_facts.text: If the security is not produced within the set period, the court may cancel it or take other appropriate measures.
The cancellation of a bearer security is published immediately in the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce and by any other means the court considers useful.
Once cancellation is pronounced, the applicant may ask for a new security at his own expense or for payment of the debt if it is due.

competing_candidates: The cancellation procedures for registered securities and for bills of exchange and cheques, which have their own rules on the effect of cancellation (the question concerns a bearer bond).
provenance.critic_notes: 986 supports all facts (fr: 'le requérant peut demander qu'un nouveau titre lui soit remis à ses frais'). 972 is the general rule (new certificate after cancellation) but lacks the publication and bearer-specific steps; 210:865 is for mortgage notes. Same-language control, FR rank 49.

question: J'ai perdu une obligation au porteur et j'ai demandé au tribunal de la déclarer sans valeur. Le délai que le juge avait fixé pour que la personne qui la détient se manifeste est maintenant passé, et personne ne l'a présentée. Que va-t-il se passer, et qu'est-ce que je peux obtenir ensuite ?

gold_facts.text: A commission agent who makes advances or grants credit to a third party without the principal's consent does so at his own risk.
Unless the principal has instructed otherwise, the commission agent may sell on credit if that is the commercial custom at the place of sale.

competing_candidates: The commission-contract article on the agent who guarantees the buyer's payment (del credere), which applies only if the agent took on that guarantee.
provenance.critic_notes: 429 supports both facts (it: 'lo fa a tutto suo rischio e pericolo'). 430 (del credere) complements the case where credit was allowed by custom; question answerable from 429. No lexical copy.

question: Ho affidato i miei quadri a un mercante d'arte perché li venda a nome suo ma per conto mio. Non gli avevo dato istruzioni sul pagamento. Lui ne ha venduto uno a un cliente lasciandogli pagare più tardi, e ora il cliente non paga. Chi sopporta la perdita, io o il mercante?

gold_facts.text: Claims for defects in the goods become time-barred two years after delivery to the buyer, even if the buyer discovers the defects later, unless the seller accepted liability for longer.

An agreement shortening the limitation period is invalid if it reduces it below two years (one year for used goods), the item is for the buyer's personal or family use, and the seller acts in a professional or commercial capacity.

competing_candidates: The sales-law article on contractual exclusion or limitation of the seller's warranty (it concerns excluding liability, not shortening the time limit).
The limitation rule for defects in a contract for work, which applies to commissioned work rather than a purchase.
provenance.critic_notes: 210 al.1 and al.4 support facts (de: 'auf weniger als zwei Jahre... verkürzt'). Notice duty in 201 al.3 is a related condition the facts ignore, but the question asks only about the time bar. DE rank 71, no copy.

question: Ich habe vor 18 Monaten bei einem Elektronikgeschäft einen neuen Fernseher für unser Wohnzimmer gekauft. Jetzt zeigt sich ein Defekt, der offenbar schon von Anfang an da war. In den Geschäftsbedingungen steht, dass Ansprüche wegen Mängeln nach einem Jahr ab Kauf erlöschen. Ist es für mich wirklich schon zu spät?

gold_facts.text: In companies with listed shares, severance payments agreed by contract or provided for in the articles of association may not be paid to current or former members of the board of directors, the executive board or the advisory board, or to persons close to them.
Payments owed until the end of the contract are not considered severance payments.

provenance.critic_notes: 735c ch.1 supports both facts (fr: 'les indemnités dues jusqu'à la fin des contrats ne sont pas considérées'). Fact 1's 'listed companies' scope comes from 732, harmless since question states listed. 735d (group) not a twin here. EN, no lexical signal.

question: I sit on the executive management of a Swiss company whose shares are traded on the stock exchange, and I am about to leave. My contract promises me a lump-sum payment of one year's salary when I go. Can the company legally pay me that? And can it at least keep paying my normal salary until my contract actually ends?

gold_facts.text: Workers employed by an employer bound by the collective agreement may individually submit to it with the consent of the contracting parties, and are then considered bound by it.
The individual declaration of submission and the consent of the parties must be in writing.

A collective agreement not concluded for a fixed term can, unless otherwise agreed, be terminated by any party after one year with six months' notice, and this applies by analogy to an individual submission.

provenance.critic_notes: 356b al.1 and 356c al.1-2 support facts (de: 'gilt sinngemäss auch für den Anschluss'). Both articles needed (right to join vs. form and termination). DE rank 75, natural.

question: Mein Arbeitgeber ist an einen Gesamtarbeitsvertrag gebunden, ich selbst bin aber in keiner Gewerkschaft. Kann ich mich diesem Vertrag trotzdem persönlich unterstellen, was muss dafür formell erfüllt sein, und wie könnte ich mich später wieder davon lösen, wenn der Vertrag ohne festes Enddatum abgeschlossen wurde?

gold_facts.text: An employer is liable for damage caused by its employees or other auxiliaries in the performance of their work.
The employer escapes liability if it proves it took all the care required by the circumstances to prevent such damage, or that the damage would have occurred even with that care.
The employer may seek recourse against the person who caused the damage to the extent that person is himself liable.

competing_candidates: The general tort liability rule for one's own fault, and the contractual rule on liability for auxiliaries (the question states there is no contract).
provenance.critic_notes: 55 al.1-2 supports all facts (fr: 's'il ne prouve qu'il a pris tous les soins commandés'). No contract, so 101 does not compete; 41 is general. Possible road-traffic (SVG) angle is outside corpus and marginal. FR rank 877.

question: En déchargeant un camion dans ma rue, un ouvrier d'une entreprise de construction a laissé tomber une planche sur ma voiture garée. Je n'ai aucun contrat avec cette entreprise. Puis-je demander à l'entreprise elle-même de payer la réparation plutôt qu'à l'ouvrier, et comment pourrait-elle y échapper ?

gold_facts.text: From the annual profit available for distribution, the allocations to reserve and other funds required by law and the articles must be made first.
The general meeting may also set aside reserves not provided for, or exceeding what is required, by law and the articles if this seems appropriate to ensure the lasting prosperity of the business.

The general meeting may, even without a basis in the articles, deduct amounts from the annual profit to create and support welfare institutions for employees, workers or members, and these are subject to the rules on statutory welfare funds.

competing_candidates: The preceding cooperative article on the legal reserve and on welfare funds set up in the articles.
The analogous stock-company rules on reserves (the brief places this article in the cooperative title).
provenance.critic_notes: 863 al.1-3 supports all facts (de: 'auch dann ausgeschieden werden, wenn sie in den Statuten nicht vorgesehen'). Question says Genossenschaft, so AG reserve rules (672-673) are excluded. DE rank 7 driven by generic 'Gesetz und Statuten'; acceptable.

question: Ich bin Mitglied einer Genossenschaft. An der Generalversammlung schlägt die Verwaltung vor, vom Jahresgewinn mehr zurückzulegen, als Gesetz und Statuten vorschreiben, und zusätzlich einen Betrag für die Altersvorsorge der Angestellten abzuzweigen, obwohl die Statuten dazu nichts sagen. Darf die Versammlung das beschliessen, bevor der Rest an die Mitglieder verteilt wird?

gold_facts.text: The obligor under a ledger-based security must inform every acquirer of the content of the right and of how the register works and is protected.
The obligor is liable for damage caused to the acquirer by incorrect, misleading or legally non-compliant information, unless it proves it exercised the required care.
Agreements that limit or exclude this liability are void.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring article on the requirements for the ledger register itself (it sets requirements, not information duties or liability).
provenance.critic_notes: 973i al.1-3 supports all facts (it: 'Qualsiasi convenzione che escluda o limiti questa responsabilità è nulla'). No twin. IT rank 56, paraphrased.

question: Ho comprato dei titoli digitali emessi da una società svizzera e iscritti in un registro su blockchain. Le spiegazioni che mi hanno dato su come funziona il registro e su come è protetto erano fuorvianti, e ci ho perso dei soldi. La società deve risarcirmi? E vale la clausola delle sue condizioni che esclude qualsiasi responsabilità?

gold_facts.text: Where members are personally liable or obliged to make additional payments, the auditor checks whether the register of members is kept correctly.
If the cooperative has no auditor, the board of directors must have the register of members checked by a licensed auditor.

competing_candidates: The cooperative article on the duty to keep a register of members (it imposes the register, not its verification).
provenance.critic_notes: 907 supports both facts (it: 'l'amministrazione fa verificare l'elenco dei soci da un revisore abilitato'). 837 (keeping the register) does not cover the audit. No twin for other company forms. No lexical signal.

question: In our cooperative, the articles say that members are personally liable for the cooperative's debts. Who has to check that the list of members is kept properly? And who does it if the cooperative has chosen not to have an auditor at all?

gold_facts.text: Where the employer is insured against civil liability and the worker has paid at least half of the premiums, the rights under the insurance belong exclusively to the worker.

competing_candidates: Insurance Contract Act rules on liability insurance and the injured party's rights (they do not deal with premiums paid by the worker).
provenance.critic_notes: 113 supports the fact (fr: 'les droits dérivant de l'assurance appartiennent exclusivement à l'employé'). 221.229.1:60 (injured third party's lien/direct claim) is related but does not allocate rights by premium share. FR rank 5 from generic words; question does not copy 'responsabilité civile'.

question: Mon patron a une assurance qui le couvre si on lui réclame des dommages-intérêts, et il retient sur mon salaire au moins la moitié des primes de cette assurance. Qui peut faire valoir les droits découlant de ce contrat d'assurance : lui ou moi ?

gold_facts.text: The general partnership acquires rights and is bound by the acts of a managing partner done in its name.
It is sufficient that the intention to act for the partnership follows from the circumstances.
The partnership is liable for damage resulting from unlawful acts committed by a partner in the conduct of the partnership's business.

competing_candidates: The following general-partnership article on the partners' personal liability for the partnership's debts.
The limited-partnership rules, which refer to the general-partnership rules on representation.
provenance.critic_notes: 567 al.1-3 supports all facts (de: 'wenn die Absicht, für die Gesellschaft zu handeln, aus den Umständen hervorgeht'). Kollektivgesellschaft stated, so 722 (AG organs) and 817 (GmbH) are told apart. DE rank 387.

question: Ich hatte mit einer Kollektivgesellschaft von zwei Brüdern zu tun. Der Bruder, der die Geschäfte führt, hat mit mir einen Liefervertrag abgeschlossen, ohne ausdrücklich zu sagen, dass er für die Firma handelt. Bei einem anderen Firmenauftrag hat er meinen Zaun mutwillig beschädigt. Muss die Gesellschaft selbst den Vertrag erfüllen und für den Schaden am Zaun aufkommen?

gold_facts.text: When a company acquires its own shares, the voting rights and associated rights attached to them are suspended.
The company must show in the balance sheet an amount equal to their acquisition cost as a deduction from equity.

Under equity, the minimum balance sheet structure lists, in order, share capital, the statutory capital reserve, the statutory retained earnings, voluntary retained earnings, own shares as a negative item, profit or loss carried forward and the annual profit or loss.

competing_candidates: The stock-company article setting the limits on acquiring own shares (it does not cover voting or balance sheet presentation).
provenance.critic_notes: 659a al.1+4 and 959a al.2 ch.3 support facts (fr: 'propres parts du capital, en diminution des capitaux propres'). 959a is needed only for 'à quel endroit précis', which 659a merely cites; acceptable cross_ref. FR rank 1 comes from the unavoidable term 'propres actions'. 783 (GmbH) is excluded by 'société anonyme'.

question: Notre société anonyme a racheté une partie de ses propres actions. Est-ce que ces actions donnent encore le droit de voter à l'assemblée générale ? Et comment et à quel endroit précis doivent-elles apparaître dans le bilan ?

gold_facts.text: The debtor may deposit the performance or withdraw from the contract, as in the case of the creditor's default, if the performance cannot be offered to the creditor or his representative for another reason relating to the creditor's person.
The same applies if there is uncertainty about who the creditor is and the debtor is not at fault for it.

competing_candidates: The articles on the creditor's default that set out how deposit and withdrawal work (they apply here by reference but do not cover the unknown-creditor case).
provenance.critic_notes: 96 supports both facts (it: 'per un'incertezza non colposa sulla persona dello stesso, il debitore può fare il deposito'). 92 (deposit procedure) complements. Note: for a thing, withdrawal works via the creditor-default rules; fact is literal. Low lexical signal.

question: Ho venduto la mia moto a un conoscente e dovevo consegnargliela questa settimana, ma nel frattempo lui è morto e nessuno sa chi siano i suoi eredi. Io non ho nessuna colpa in questo. Che cosa posso fare, visto che non ho nessuno a cui consegnarla?

gold_facts.text: If a commercial traveller is prevented from travelling through no fault of his own and is still entitled to pay, the pay consists of the fixed salary plus fair compensation for the lost commission.
If commission is less than one fifth of the pay, it may be agreed in writing that no compensation for lost commission is due during such a period.
If the traveller still receives full pay, he must on the employer's request work in the employer's business, provided he is able to and it can reasonably be expected of him.

competing_candidates: The general employment-contract rule on continued pay when the worker is prevented from working by illness or accident (the question assumes pay is owed).
provenance.critic_notes: 349c al.1-3 supports all facts (de: 'hat er auf Verlangen des Arbeitgebers Arbeit in dessen Betrieb zu leisten'). 418m (agent) is excluded by employer/fixed salary. EN, no lexical signal.

question: I work as a travelling sales rep on a fixed salary plus commission. I broke my leg and cannot visit customers for two months, through no fault of my own, and my employer has to keep paying me during that time. Is my pay just the fixed salary, or do I also get something for the commission I am missing? And can my boss make me work in the office instead while I'm off the road?

gold_facts.text: The employer must grant at least four weeks of holiday per year of service, and at least five weeks to workers up to the age of 20.
If the year of service is incomplete, the holiday is set in proportion to the length of the employment.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring employment-contract articles on when holidays are taken and on holiday pay (they do not set the length).
provenance.critic_notes: 329a al.1+3 supports both facts (fr: 'cinq semaines au moins aux travailleurs jusqu'à l'âge de 20 ans'). Same-language control, FR rank 1 although the question says 'congés' not 'vacances'; generic tokens. 329d (pay-out at end) is not asked.

question: J'ai 19 ans et je quitte mon emploi après seulement huit mois chez cet employeur. Combien de congés payés devais-je recevoir au minimum, et est-ce que j'ai droit à une année complète de congés alors que je ne suis pas resté un an ?

gold_facts.text: The auditor checks whether an internal control system exists and, for companies whose shares are listed on a stock exchange, whether the compensation report complies with the law and the articles.
The board of directors' management of the company is not subject to the auditor's review.

competing_candidates: The stock-company article on the scope of a limited audit, which also excludes the board's management from review (the question states a full, not a limited audit, and asks about the internal control system and compensation report, which only A covers).
provenance.critic_notes: Paraphrased; DE rank 23 (was 3). de 728a: 'ein internes Kontrollsystem existiert'; (3) 'Geschäftsführung ... nicht Gegenstand'. Ordinary-audit and ICS/compensation cues exclude 220:729a.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: paraphrased to avoid copying the article's terms. Dropped the fact on annual accounts and profit proposal, which the question does not ask.

question: Ich bin Aktionär einer börsenkotierten AG, deren Jahresrechnung voll und nicht bloss eingeschränkt geprüft werden muss. Schaut der Prüfer nach, ob die Firma überhaupt Vorkehrungen zur Überwachung ihrer eigenen Abläufe hat und ob der Bericht über die Bezüge der Spitzenleute stimmt? Und beurteilt er auch, ob die Unternehmensspitze die Firma gut geführt hat?

gold_facts.text: In commercial dealings, where a specific delivery date was agreed and the seller is in default, the buyer is presumed to waive delivery and to claim damages for non-performance.
If the buyer prefers to demand delivery, he must notify the seller immediately after the delivery date has passed.

competing_candidates: The general rules on the creditor's options when the debtor is in default under a bilateral contract (A sets a special presumption for commercial sales with a fixed date).
provenance.critic_notes: 190 al.1-2 supports both facts (it: 'si presume che il compratore... rinunci alla consegna'). 'si presume' echoes the text but IT rank 29; 191 (damages calculation) not asked. Commercial context stated.

question: Ho un negozio di articoli sportivi e ho ordinato a un grossista una partita di costumi da bagno con consegna fissata per il primo maggio. Il fornitore è in ritardo. Che cosa si presume che io voglia a questo punto, e se invece voglio comunque ricevere la merce, che cosa devo fare?

gold_facts.text: If one sex is not represented by at least 30 percent on the board of directors and at least 20 percent on the executive board of a company exceeding the relevant thresholds, the compensation report must state the reasons.
The compensation report must also state the measures taken to promote the under-represented sex.

The thresholds are met when a company exceeds, in two consecutive financial years, two of the following: a balance sheet total of CHF 20 million, a turnover of CHF 40 million, and 250 full-time positions on annual average.

provenance.critic_notes: 734f and 727 al.1 ch.2 support facts (it: 'supera i valori soglia di cui all articolo 727 capoverso 1 numero 2'). 727 needed for the size question. Transitional 220:u10/4 phases in the board duty (from FY five years after entry into force, i.e. now applicable), so no conflict. IT rank 7, natural terms.

question: Lavoro in una grande società anonima quotata in borsa: nel consiglio di amministrazione le donne sono solo il 10 per cento. La società è obbligata a giustificare pubblicamente questa situazione e a dire cosa intende fare? E a partire da quali dimensioni dell'azienda vale questo obbligo?

gold_facts.text: Lotteries and prize draws give rise to an enforceable claim only if they were authorised by the competent authority, otherwise the rules on gambling debts apply.
Lotteries authorised abroad do not enjoy legal protection in Switzerland unless the competent authority has permitted the sale of the tickets.

competing_candidates: The article on gambling and betting debts, which says they cannot be enforced (A applies it to unauthorised lotteries).
provenance.critic_notes: 515 al.1-3 supports both facts (fr: 'ne jouissent pas, en Suisse, de la protection de la loi, à moins que'). 513 (gambling debts) is the referred rule, not needed. Answer is conditional on Swiss permit, covered by fact 2. EN, no lexical signal.

question: I bought tickets in Switzerland for a prize draw that is licensed in another country, and I won. The organiser now refuses to pay out. Can I go to a Swiss court to force them to pay my winnings?

gold_facts.text: A debtor in default must compensate the damage caused by late performance and is also liable for accidental loss.

He escapes this liability if he proves that the default occurred through no fault of his own, or that the accident would also have struck the object to the creditor's detriment had he performed on time.

competing_candidates: The contract-for-work rule on who bears the risk when the work or the client's material perishes before delivery (it does not address a contractor already in default).
provenance.critic_notes: 103 supports both facts (fr: 'répond même du cas fortuit'). 376 al.2 (loss of customer-supplied material falls on supplier) is a related general rule but the stated default makes 103 decisive. FR rank 11, paraphrased.

question: Un restaurateur devait me rendre mon tableau le 1er mars. Il a traîné sans aucune excuse, et le 10 mars un incendie dont il n'est pas responsable a détruit son atelier avec mon tableau. Il dit qu'il n'y est pour rien. Doit-il quand même m'indemniser, et dans quels cas pourrait-il s'en sortir ?

gold_facts.text: Unless a shorter period or other pay period is agreed, customary or set by a standard or collective employment contract, the salary is paid at the end of each month.
A share in the business result is paid as soon as the result is established, but no later than six months after the end of the financial year.

competing_candidates: The employment-contract article on how a profit share is calculated and the worker's right to information (it does not set the due date).
provenance.critic_notes: 323 al.1+3 supports both facts (de: 'spätestens jedoch sechs Monate nach Ablauf des Geschäftsjahres'). 339 al.3 only refers back. DE rank 5 driven by 'Gesamtarbeitsvertrag', 'Lohn'; tolerable.

question: In meinem Arbeitsvertrag steht nichts dazu, wann der Lohn ausbezahlt wird, und für meine Branche gibt es keinen Gesamtarbeitsvertrag. Wann muss mein Arbeitgeber mir den Lohn zahlen? Und ich bin am Jahresgewinn beteiligt: bis wann muss dieser Anteil spätestens ausbezahlt sein?

gold_facts.text: Costs the consumer must pay for failing to meet any contractual obligation are not taken into account in calculating the effective annual interest rate.
Insurance costs are included if the insurance is imposed as mandatory by the lender for granting the credit.

They are included only if the insurance secures repayment to the lender, in case of the consumer's death, invalidity, illness or unemployment, of an amount up to the total credit including interest and other costs.

competing_candidates: The articles defining the total cost of credit and the effective annual interest rate are topically close.
provenance.critic_notes: 34 al.2 let.a and al.4 support all facts (de: 'die Kosten für Versicherungen... zwingend vorschreibt'). 5 and 33 do not answer it. EN, no lexical signal.

question: My consumer lender made me take out insurance that pays off the loan if I die, become disabled, fall ill or lose my job. When the yearly percentage cost of the loan is calculated, must that insurance premium be counted in? And what about the fees I would owe if I paid late?

gold_facts.text: The consumer may revoke in writing, within fourteen days, the offer to conclude the contract or the acceptance.
The right of revocation does not apply to the case of a tacitly accepted overdraft lasting more than three months.
If an overdraft is tacitly accepted and lasts beyond three months, the consumer must be informed of the annual interest rate and any applicable fees.
The consumer must also be informed of any change to that rate or those fees.

provenance.critic_notes: 16 al.1 and 12 al.4 support facts (it: 'Se uno scoperto è tacitamente accettato e si protrae oltre tre mesi'). Both needed (no revocation vs. information duty). Ranks 51-148, paraphrased.
provenance.writer_note: The exception in A points to paragraph 4 of B, which is the tacit overdraft rule.

question: La banca mi ha lasciato andare in rosso sul conto corrente senza alcun accordo esplicito, e il saldo negativo dura ormai da quattro mesi. Posso ripensarci entro due settimane come per un normale prestito al consumo? E la banca è obbligata a dirmi qualcosa sugli interessi che mi addebita?

gold_facts.text: If the claimant or their representative, in order to deceive, misstated or concealed facts that would exclude or reduce the insurer's liability, the insurer is not bound by the contract towards the claimant.

competing_candidates: Code of Obligations rules on fraud in contract conclusion and the insurance act rules on breach of pre-contractual disclosure are topically close but concern other moments.
provenance.critic_notes: Notification fact removed. de 40: 'zum Zwecke der Täuschung unrichtig mitgeteilt ... an den Vertrag nicht gebunden'. Closest 221.229.1:38b, 221.229.1:6; no lexical signal.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: removed the fact on late or missing notifications.

question: After a burglary I told my insurer the door had been locked, although I had actually left it open, because I feared they would pay less. If they find out I said this on purpose to mislead them, what happens to my cover?

gold_facts.text: Before the contract is concluded, the insurer must inform the policyholder comprehensibly and in text form about the essential content of the contract, including the right of revocation and its form and deadline.
This information must be given so that the policyholder can know it when proposing or accepting the contract.
The policyholder may revoke the proposal or the acceptance in writing or text form within fourteen days from proposing or accepting the contract.
The deadline is met if the revocation is communicated to the insurer or handed to the post office by the last day of the period.

competing_candidates: The insurance act article on the consequences of breaching the insurer's information duty is topically close.
provenance.critic_notes: it 2a(2): «Il termine di revoca è di quattordici giorni e decorre ...»; Art.3(1)(h) requires informing on revocation, form and deadline. Both articles needed. Twins (doorstep 220:40d/40e, consumer credit 221.214.1:16) excluded by «assurance ménage». 221.229.1:2b (effects) not asked.
provenance.writer_note: Household insurance chosen so that the exclusions in B (collective personal insurance, provisional cover, contracts under one month) do not apply.

question: Je viens de signer une assurance ménage. Mon assureur aurait-il dû m'expliquer avant la signature que je pouvais encore changer d'avis ? Et concrètement, de combien de temps je dispose pour revenir en arrière et comment dois-je m'y prendre ?

gold_facts.text: If the insurer breached its duty to inform, the policyholder may terminate the insurance contract in writing or in another form that allows proof by text, effective on receipt by the insurer.
The termination right lapses four weeks after the policyholder learns of the breach and of the required information.
The termination right lapses at the latest two years after the breach.

competing_candidates: The article setting out the insurer's information duty itself is topically close but does not give the remedy.
provenance.critic_notes: Italian now grammatical. de 3a(2): 'erlischt vier Wochen ... spätestens zwei Jahre nach der Pflichtverletzung'. 221.229.1:6 excluded by scenario.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: Italian grammar fixed.

question: Ho scoperto solo adesso che la mia compagnia, prima che firmassi, non mi aveva spiegato, come avrebbe dovuto, gli elementi essenziali della polizza. Posso uscire dal contratto per questo motivo? Come devo fare e fino a quando posso farlo?

gold_facts.text: Correction, erasure or destruction of personal data cannot be demanded for the holdings of institutions open to the public such as libraries, educational institutions, museums, archives and other public heritage institutions.
If the claimant credibly shows an overriding interest, he or she can require the institution to restrict access to the disputed data.

competing_candidates: The Civil Code articles on protection of personality and the Data Protection Act claims against private persons, which do not contain this rule for federal bodies' public collections.
provenance.critic_notes: fr 41(5): «ne peut pas être exigée pour les fonds gérés par des institutions ouvertes au public». Only 235.1:41 mentions libraries in the corpus. Closest: 235.1:32 (claims against private persons, no such rule).

question: A federal public library keeps an old newspaper in its collection that contains false and embarrassing information about me. Can I force the library to correct or delete that information, and if not, is there anything else I can ask it to do?

gold_facts.text: The controller must inform the data subject of a data security breach when this is necessary for the data subject's protection or when the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner requires it.
The controller may restrict, defer or waive informing the data subject where one of the specific grounds on which a federal body may restrict a data subject's right of access applies.
For a federal body, one such ground is that communicating the information is likely to compromise an investigation, an inquiry or judicial or administrative proceedings.

provenance.critic_notes: Fact 2 narrowed; true for a federal body (24(5)(a) via 26(2)(b)). fr 26(2)(b)(2): 'susceptible de compromettre une enquête, une instruction'. Cross-ref needed.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: fact 2 narrowed to the federal-body access-restriction grounds the article refers to (no longer any access-restriction ground). Dropped the public-security ground, which the question does not ask.

question: Une administration fédérale a été victime d'un piratage informatique et des dossiers de citoyens ont fuité. Une enquête pénale est en cours et la police craint que prévenir les personnes touchées maintenant ne la fasse échouer. L'administration doit-elle quand même avertir ces personnes, ou peut-elle attendre ou y renoncer?

gold_facts.text: Controllers and processors must ensure, through appropriate technical and organisational measures, a level of security of personal data that is adequate to the risk.
The measures must make it possible to avoid data security breaches.
The Federal Council issues provisions on the minimum data security requirements.

competing_candidates: The Data Protection Act article on processing by processors, which requires the controller to ensure the processor can guarantee data security.
The Data Protection Act article on data protection by design and by default.
provenance.critic_notes: fr: «une sécurité adéquate des données personnelles par rapport au risque encouru». Facts supported in all three. 235.1:9(2) (controller must check processor security) partly answers the outsourcing angle but not the security duty itself.

question: Ho un piccolo studio di fisioterapia e conservo le schede dei pazienti su un server gestito da una ditta informatica esterna. Che cosa pretende la legge da me e da quella ditta per proteggere questi dati da furti o perdite?

gold_facts.text: An operator of an online platform for booking accommodation services acts unfairly if its general terms and conditions directly or indirectly restrict the price and offer setting of accommodation businesses through parity clauses.
This covers parity clauses concerning price, availability or conditions in particular.

competing_candidates: The Unfair Competition Act article on unfair general terms and conditions, which protects consumers rather than businesses.
provenance.critic_notes: de: «Betreiber einer Online-Plattform zur Buchung von Beherbergungsdienstleistungen». fr rank 1 comes from unavoidable descriptive terms (plateforme, réservation, conditions générales); the question avoids «clause de parité». Closest: 241:8 (unfair terms toward consumers).

question: Je tiens un petit hôtel à la montagne. La plateforme de réservation en ligne sur laquelle je propose mes chambres m'interdit, dans ses conditions générales, de les offrir moins cher ou à de meilleures conditions sur mon propre site. Est-ce que la plateforme a le droit de m'imposer cela?

gold_facts.text: If a domain name was used to commit a punishable act of unfair competition and this is necessary to prevent further offences, the public prosecutor or the court may order the revocation of a second-level domain name under an internet domain managed by Switzerland, regardless of whether a specific person is punishable.
The authority conducting the proceedings may order the provisional blocking of the domain name until the end of the criminal proceedings.
Anyone who intentionally commits unfair competition is liable on complaint to a custodial sentence of up to three years or a monetary penalty.
Anyone entitled to bring a civil action under the Unfair Competition Act may file the complaint.

provenance.critic_notes: it 26a(1): «il pubblico ministero o il giudice può ... ordinare ... la revoca del nome di dominio»; 23 gives penalty and complaint. Both needed. Same-language control, it rank 1 driven by «dominio» (unique concept word). No other domain rule in corpus.

question: Un concorrente usa un sito con indirizzo .ch per diffondere di proposito affermazioni false sui miei prodotti, per portarmi via i clienti. Se presento una denuncia penale, si può anche far togliere o bloccare quel dominio? Chi può denunciare e che pena rischia il responsabile?

gold_facts.text: For claims for damages caused by unjustified interim measures, the court at the domicile or registered office of the defendant has jurisdiction.
The court at the place where the interim measure was ordered also has jurisdiction.

competing_candidates: The civil procedure article on the applicant's liability for damage caused by unjustified interim measures (it sets the liability, not the venue).
The general venue rule for tort claims in the same section.
provenance.critic_notes: de: «Gericht am Wohnsitz oder Sitz der beklagten Partei oder an dem Ort, an dem die vorsorgliche Massnahme angeordnet wurde». Closest: 272:264 and 272:374 (liability, not venue), 272:36 (tort venue).

question: A competitor got a court to impose an urgent temporary ban on us selling one of our products. The ban later turned out to be unjustified and we lost a lot of sales in the meantime. If we sue the competitor for our losses, which court can we bring that case in?

gold_facts.text: If the operative part of a decision is unclear, ambiguous or incomplete, or contradicts the reasons, the court interprets or corrects the decision on request of a party or of its own motion.
The request must state the contested points and the desired changes.
The decision on the request for interpretation or correction can be challenged by an objection (complaint).

competing_candidates: The civil procedure rules on appeal and on revision, which are other ways to attack a decision but not a request to the same court to clarify or correct it.
provenance.critic_notes: it: «Nella domanda devono essere indicati i punti contestati e le modifiche auspicate.» 334(3) challenge by Beschwerde. Closest: 272:328 (revision), 272:308/319 (appeals). fr rank 140.

question: Dans le jugement que j'ai reçu, la phrase finale qui dit combien l'autre partie doit me payer contient une erreur de calcul et ne correspond pas à ce que le juge explique plus haut dans ses motifs. Est-ce que je peux demander au même tribunal de clarifier ou de corriger cela, que dois-je indiquer dans ma demande, et puis-je contester ce qu'il décidera ?

gold_facts.text: On the defendant's request, the plaintiff must provide security for party costs if it still owes court costs from earlier proceedings.
There is no duty to provide security in the simplified procedure, except in pecuniary disputes that fall under that procedure because of their value in dispute.
The simplified procedure applies to pecuniary disputes with a value in dispute of up to CHF 30,000.

competing_candidates: The civil procedure article on the advance on court costs, which concerns court fees rather than security for the other party's costs.
provenance.critic_notes: Swiss domicile removes treaty issue. de 99(1)(c) 'Prozesskosten aus früheren Verfahren schuldet'; 99(3)(a) exception; 243(1) 30 000. Gold 'yes' holds (commercial court unavailable at 20k).
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: plaintiff now lives in Switzerland (no treaty issue); the ground is unpaid costs from earlier proceedings. Answer: yes, security is owed; the 20,000 claim is in the simplified procedure only by value, which is the exception to the exemption.

question: Ich wohne in Zürich und klage vor einem Schweizer Gericht gegen eine Firma auf Zahlung von 20'000 Franken aus einem Kaufvertrag. Aus einem früheren Gerichtsverfahren habe ich die Kosten bis heute nicht bezahlt. Die Firma verlangt jetzt, dass ich vorab eine Sicherheit für ihre Anwaltskosten hinterlege. Muss ich das bei einem so kleinen Betrag überhaupt?

gold_facts.text: The court serves the statement of claim on the defendant and at the same time sets a deadline for a written statement of defence.
The defendant must set out in detail which of the plaintiff's factual allegations are admitted and which are disputed.

competing_candidates: The following article on what happens if the statement of defence is not filed in time, and the preceding article on the content of the statement of claim, which applies by analogy.
provenance.critic_notes: it: «Il convenuto deve specificare quali fatti, così come esposti dall’attore, riconosce o contesta.» Facts supported; deadline is court-set, not a number. Closest: 272:223 (failure to file), 272:221. No lexical signal.

question: Un ex socio mi ha fatto causa davanti al tribunale civile con la procedura normale per iscritto, e ho appena ricevuto l'atto con cui mi cita. Come ed entro quando devo rispondere, e devo prendere posizione su ogni singola cosa che lui afferma?

gold_facts.text: The court must notify the debt enforcement offices, the bankruptcy offices, the commercial register and the land register without delay of the declaration of bankruptcy.
The same notification is required for the revocation and the closure of the bankruptcy, decisions granting suspensive effect to an appeal, and protective measures ordered.
The bankruptcy must be noted in the land register no later than two days after it is opened.

competing_candidates: The bankruptcy article on public notice of the bankruptcy by the bankruptcy office, which concerns publication rather than notification of offices and registers.
provenance.critic_notes: FR: 'Le juge communique sans retard aux offices des poursuites, aux offices des faillites...'; al.2 'au plus tard deux jours'. Revocation listed (ch.2). All facts supported. No competing article found; EN natural.

question: A court has just declared a company bankrupt, and the company owns a warehouse. Which public offices and registers does the court have to inform, how quickly must the bankruptcy show up in the land register, and does the court also have to inform them if the bankruptcy is later revoked?

gold_facts.text: A creditor whose enforcement is met with an objection must assert his claim in civil or administrative proceedings.
He can request continuation of the enforcement only on the basis of an enforceable decision that expressly sets aside the objection.

competing_candidates: The enforcement articles on setting aside the objection on the basis of a judgment or a signed acknowledgement of debt; the question excludes both.
provenance.critic_notes: DE: 'hat seinen Anspruch im Zivilprozess oder im Verwaltungsverfahren geltend zu machen'. Supported de/fr/it. DE rank 1, but only via standard terms (Betreibung, Rechtsvorschlag) a layperson would use; no copied phrasing. 281.1:80/82 excluded by question.

question: Ich habe gegen einen ehemaligen Kunden eine Betreibung über 5'000 Franken eingeleitet, aber er hat Rechtsvorschlag erhoben. Ich habe weder ein Urteil noch ein von ihm unterschriebenes Papier, in dem er die Schuld zugibt. Was muss ich jetzt tun, damit die Betreibung weitergehen kann?

gold_facts.text: The debtor can request the opening of bankruptcy himself by declaring to the court that he is insolvent.
The judge opens bankruptcy if there is no prospect of a settlement of debts under the debt-settlement rules.
On bankruptcy, all pending enforcement proceedings against the debtor are cancelled.
New enforcement for claims that arose before the opening of bankruptcy cannot be started during the bankruptcy proceedings.

competing_candidates: The articles on the amicable debt settlement procedure for private debtors, which are the alternative the judge checks but do not state the effects of bankruptcy.
provenance.critic_notes: 191 IT: 'il giudice dichiara il fallimento' if no 'appuramento bonale'; 206 al.1 'esecuzioni in corso ... cessano'. Both articles needed, each answers one half. IT rank 5, wording paraphrased. Difficulty should be hard (two articles).

question: Sono un dipendente sommerso dai debiti e ho già diverse procedure di riscossione in corso contro di me. Se mi presento in tribunale dichiarando che non riesco più a pagare, a quali condizioni il giudice apre il mio fallimento? E una volta aperto, che fine fanno le procedure già avviate e possono i creditori avviarne di nuove per quei debiti vecchi?

gold_facts.text: If the liquidators or the creditors' committee waive a disputed or hard-to-recover claim, such as an avoidance action or a liability action against the debtor's officers or employees, they must inform the creditors by circular or by official publication.
They must offer the creditors the assignment of those claims.

competing_candidates: The bankruptcy article on assignment of the estate's claims to creditors, to which this article refers; the question concerns a composition with assignment of assets, not bankruptcy.
provenance.critic_notes: FR: 'ils en informeront les créanciers par circulaire ou par publication officielle et leur offriront la cession'. Supported de/fr/it. Bankruptcy twin 281.1:260 distinguished by composition-with-assignment framing. Easy fine.

question: Une entreprise qui me doit de l'argent a conclu avec ses créanciers un accord par lequel elle leur cède tout son patrimoine pour qu'il soit vendu et le produit réparti. Les personnes chargées de la liquidation ne veulent pas poursuivre en justice les anciens dirigeants, qu'on soupçonne d'avoir mal géré l'entreprise. En tant que créancier, puis-je reprendre cette action moi-même, et comment en serai-je informé ?

provenance.critic_notes: Now asks only for recognised providers and price. 220:59a, 220:14 and 210:u1/55a refer to recognised providers under ZertES generically; no list or fees in the 8 acts. Closest 220:14.
provenance.writer_note: Likely wrong retrieval: Code of Obligations article on signatures, which equates a qualified electronic signature with a handwritten one.

question: I want to sign a contract online so that it has the same legal effect as a handwritten signature. Which providers are currently recognised in Switzerland to issue the certificates for such a signature, and what does one cost?
trap_reason: The Code of Obligations only refers to recognised certification providers in general; which providers are currently recognised and their prices are set outside the 8 acts (the electronic signatures legislation and market practice).

provenance.critic_notes: Searched Motorfahrzeug/Haftpflichtversicherung and FR/IT vehicle terms: only 221.229.1:59/60 (compulsory liability insurance generally), 220:327b, 272:38. No minimum cover. Not answerable; pointer 221.229.1:59 weak.
provenance.writer_note: Likely wrong retrieval: Insurance Contract Act articles on liability insurance.

question: Ich kaufe mein erstes Auto. Wie hoch muss die Haftpflichtversicherung für das Fahrzeug mindestens sein, damit ich es einlösen kann?
trap_reason: Compulsory motor vehicle liability insurance and its minimum cover are governed by the Road Traffic Act and its ordinance, not by the Insurance Contract Act.

provenance.critic_notes: 220:748-750 repealed (Merger Act, 1.7.2004). In-force mentions only 220:181 al.4 (refers to Merger Act) and 220:738 (no liquidation on merger). No steps or effective date. Not answerable; pointer 220:738 reasonable.
provenance.writer_note: Likely wrong retrieval: Code of Obligations articles on dissolution of a stock company and on taking over assets and liabilities.

question: Due società anonime vogliono fondersi in un'unica società. Quali passi prevede il Codice delle obbligazioni per la fusione, e da quando la fusione produce i suoi effetti?
trap_reason: The Code of Obligations' provisions on mergers of stock companies were repealed with effect from 1 July 2004 and the topic moved to the Merger Act.

provenance.critic_notes: 241:16 (de/fr/it): obligation applies to services 'désignées par le Conseil fédéral'; FC regulates indication. Act does not say whether hairdressing is designated or the form. Not answerable; pointer 241:16 reasonable.
provenance.writer_note: Likely wrong retrieval: Unfair Competition Act articles on the duty to indicate prices.

question: Je tiens un salon de coiffure. Suis-je obligé d'afficher mes prix dans la vitrine, et sous quelle forme : TVA comprise, prestation par prestation, en francs suisses ?
trap_reason: The Unfair Competition Act only says that the Federal Council regulates price indication; which services are covered and how prices must be shown is set by the Price Indication Ordinance.

question: The conciliation hearing failed and I was authorised to take my CHF 25,000 claim against a former business partner to court in Geneva. Which Geneva court is competent, and which of its chambers deals with ordinary contract claims of that size?

question: Io e la mia fidanzata vogliamo sposarci a Bellinzona. Quali documenti precisi dobbiamo portare all'ufficio dello stato civile, e quanto costa la procedura preparatoria?
